help_photo_frame: Family photos from a folder, a list or a state, with cross-fade, slow zoom, date and place from EXIF and an optional clock. As a tile or a whole page.
help_screensaver: After some minutes without input, photos with clock and weather lie over every view. A touch ends it without switching anything.
screensaver_hint: Only visible in the editor. In the runtime the screensaver lies over every view of the project after the waiting time.
timeout_tooltip: Minutes without input until the screensaver starts. 0 = never: e.g. on a view with a camera, together with "Only this view".
scope_tooltip: A screensaver for a single view wins over the one for the whole project.
after_view_tooltip: Opened while the screensaver runs. Empty: back to the last view.
end_on_mouse_move_tooltip: On a PC moving the mouse already ends the screensaver, not only a click.
enabled_oid_tooltip: Optional. false switches the screensaver off, e.g. at night.
dim_oid_tooltip: Optional. true dims the screensaver to the brightness below; a number is the brightness in percent.
dim_level_tooltip: Brightness of the photos while the dim state is true.
source_tooltip: Where the pictures come from. Access data of photo services do not belong here: the settings of a widget can be read in the browser. Let an adapter write the list into a state instead.
folder_tooltip: A folder of the ioBroker file storage, e.g. 0_userdata.0/fotos, or _PRJ_NAME/fotos for a folder of the project. Upload pictures with the button or the file manager. New pictures appear without a restart.
recursive_tooltip: Also show the pictures of the subfolders.
album_oid_tooltip: Optional. A state whose value replaces the folder or the album above (e.g. 0_userdata.0/fotos/christmas, or the ID of an album of the adapter): so a script can switch the album.
urls_tooltip: One URL per line, optionally followed by | and a caption. Lines starting with # are skipped.
list_oid_tooltip: A state with a JSON list of entries { "url", "date", "place", "caption" }, a list of URLs or a single URL. This is how scripts and adapters (Immich, Synology Photos, ...) deliver pictures.
order_tooltip: In order of the names, or random. In random order new pictures come next.
transition_tooltip: How one picture follows the other.
ken_burns_tooltip: A slight zoom while a picture stands (Ken Burns effect).
fit_tooltip: Fill: the edge of the picture is cut off. Show whole: instead of black bars, a blurred and darkened copy of the same picture fills the rest.
pair_portraits_tooltip: If the frame is landscape, two portrait pictures in a row are shown next to each other.
dots_tooltip: Dots for the position in the list; with many pictures a counter.
caption_position_tooltip: Where the caption stands. If the clock is in the same corner, the caption moves to the other one.
show_date_tooltip: When the photo was taken: from the list or from the EXIF data of the photo.
place_source_tooltip: Where the photo was taken: from the list or from the place names in the file (XMP/IPTC). With OpenStreetMap the GPS coordinates of phone photos are looked up as well - the coordinates are then sent to openstreetmap.org.
place_osm: Also look up GPS at OpenStreetMap
show_photo_caption_tooltip: The caption from the list or from the file (description in XMP/IPTC).
caption_text_tooltip: A free text for every picture without a caption of its own, e.g. "Family Müller".
show_clock_tooltip: Time and date large over the picture: for a whole page and the screensaver.
info_position_tooltip: Where the clock and the weather stand.
weather_tooltip: Optional: the weather card under the clock appears as soon as a state for the temperature, the text or the icon is set.
weather_text_tooltip: E.g. "Snowfall". Also chooses the symbol if no icon state is set.
weather_icon_tooltip: A WMO weather code (open-meteo), a text or the URL of a picture.
without_card_tooltip: No corners, frame and shadow: for a whole page as a picture frame.
interactive_tooltip: Swipe or tap at the edge: next or previous picture. Tap in the middle: pause and continue.
button_oid_tooltip: Optional. Every write to this state (e.g. by a button) changes the picture.
pause_oid_tooltip: Optional. true pauses the slideshow. A tap in the middle writes this state.
choose_source: Choose where the pictures come from
folder_unsupported: This page cannot read folders: choose a list of URLs or a state
wc_folder_tooltip: A folder of the ioBroker file storage, e.g. 0_userdata.0/fotos. Upload pictures with the file manager of Admin; new pictures appear without a restart.
wc_screensaver_desc: After some minutes without input, photos with clock and weather lie over the whole page. A touch ends it without switching anything; a tap on the tile starts it at once.
wc_timeout_tooltip: Minutes without input until the screensaver starts. 0 = never.
instance_tooltip: The instance of the screensaver adapter that keeps the albums
album_tooltip: An album as set up in the instance of the adapter: a folder of the ioBroker files, a folder of the server or Immich
album_none_configured: %s has no album yet: add one in the settings of the instance
album_unreachable: %s does not answer: is the instance running?
date_filter_tooltip: By the day a picture was taken: all, the last days, a period, or this day some years ago
days_tooltip: Today and the days before: 1 is today, 7 the last week
date_range_tooltip: A day like 2024-07-01, both days included; empty is open
years_ago_tooltip: 1 is today a year ago, 2 two years ago; 0 is this day in every year before
window_days_tooltip: Days before and after that count too; 0 is the day alone
filter_fallback_tooltip: On a day without pictures of that day, the frame shows the whole album instead of nothing
